sources_considered.why: Primary confirmation that AI was included without an additional charge.
Readable transcript of management explaining that AI use was priced into the paid plan. It supplies no realized per-interaction cost.
Confirms bundled access and management's claim of falling costs, but adds no measurable per-interaction profitability.
Company-wide results for an earlier period cannot establish the profitability of the relevant AI interactions.

evidence_items.locator: Changes for Atlassian Intelligence across products in Premium and Enterprise plans
evidence_items.explanation: This establishes the stated bundling scenario. It does not disclose the vendor's marginal costs or the contribution from the paid subscription.

evidence_items.publisher: Box, transcript hosted by Stock Analysis
evidence_items.locator: Final Q&A, Aaron Levie's response on AI costs and margins
evidence_items.explanation: In the surrounding answer, Box says included AI use was priced into Enterprise Plus and forecasts that AI would not dilute gross margin. This challenges treating included access as having no attributable revenue, but is a pricing strategy and forecast rather than realized profitability evidence.

unresolved_gaps: No actual per-interaction vendor cost records were found.
No allocation of subscription revenue to included AI features was disclosed.
No evidence establishes positive incremental expense for every interaction.
The claim does not specify an accounting basis.
